description_en: Queries information about one or more cloud accounts by using paging
description_zh: 分页查询一个或者多个云账号信息
name: ListCloudAccounts

parameters.help_en:
The token that identifies the start position of the next page.

If this parameter is not specified, the query starts from the first page
parameters.help_zh:
用于标识下一个分页的起始位置的 Token。

当不传时，默认从第一页开始查询
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of records per page.

If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 20.

The maximum value is 100
parameters.help_zh:
分页的最大记录数。

当不传递时默认为20。

限制最大值不超过100
parameters.name: max_results

fields.help_en:
The filter field name. Valid values:

CloudAccountId: the cloud account ID.
CloudAccountExternalId: the external unique identifier of the cloud account.
CloudAccountVendorType: the cloud account type
fields.help_zh:
过滤字段名称。取值可选范围：

CloudAccountId：云账号ID。
CloudAccountExternalId：云账号外部唯一标识。
CloudAccountVendorType：云账号类型
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The list of filter field values
fields.name: value

CloudAccountExternalId.description_en: The external unique identifier of the cloud account

CloudAccountHealth.description_en:
The health status of the cloud account. Valid values:
healthy: Healthy.
unhealthy: Unhealthy.
unknown: Unknown
CloudAccountHealth.description_zh:
云账号健康状态。取值可选范围：
healthy：健康。
unhealthy：不健康。
unknown：未知

CloudAccountHealthCheckResult.description_en: The health check result of the cloud account
CloudAccountHealthCheckResult.description_zh: 云账号健康状态检查结果

ErrorReason.description_en: The error reason. This field is returned when the health check status is unhealthy
ErrorReason.description_zh: 错误原因。当健康检查状态为 unhealthy 时，该字段会返回值

LastCheckTime.description_en: The last check time, in UNIX timestamp format, measured in milliseconds
LastCheckTime.description_zh: 最后一次检测时间，Unix 时间戳格式，单位为毫秒

Result.description_en:
The health check result of the cloud account. Valid values:
success: Succeeded.
failed: Failed
Result.description_zh:
云账号健康检查结果。取值可选范围：
success：成功。
failed：失败

CloudAccountSite.description_en:
The cloud account site. Valid values:
china_mainland: The Chinese mainland.
global: Global
CloudAccountSite.description_zh:
云账号站点
china_mainland：中国内地。
global：全球

CloudAccountVendorType.description_en:
The cloud account type. Valid values:

alibaba_cloud: Alibaba Cloud
CloudAccountVendorType.description_zh:
云账号类型。取值可选范围：

alibaba_cloud：阿里云

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time, in UNIX timestamp format, measured in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，Unix 时间戳格式，单位为毫秒

PrivilegeApplicationIds.description_en: The list of associated privilege application IDs

PrivilegeHostingError.description_en: The reason for the privilege hosting or removal failure
PrivilegeHostingError.description_zh: 特权托管或移除失败原因
PrivilegeHostingError.title_en: 特权托管或移除失败原因
PrivilegeHostingError.title_zh: 特权托管或移除失败原因

PrivilegeHostingState.description_en:
The hosting state of the cloud account. The default value is unmanaged. Valid values:
hosting_unmanaged: Unmanaged. The cloud account has not initiated hosting and is in the initial state.
hosting_pending: Hosting in progress. The hosting task has been submitted and is being executed asynchronously. Wait for the hosting process to complete before the final state is reached.
hosting_completed: Hosting completed. The cloud account hosting process was executed successfully, and the related permission templates and hosting bindings have taken effect.
hosting_failed: Hosting failed. The hosting process encountered an exception. View the failure reason and re-initiate hosting.
hosting_removing: Removal in progress. The removal task has been submitted and is being executed asynchronously. Wait for the removal process to complete before the final state is reached.
hosting_remove_failed: Removal failed. The removal process encountered an exception. View the failure reason and re-initiate removal
PrivilegeHostingState.description_zh:
云账号托管状态，默认为未托管，取值可选范围：
hosting_unmanaged：未托管，云账号尚未发起托管，处于初始状态。
hosting_pending：托管中，托管任务已提交并异步执行中，需等待托管流程完成后进入最终状态。
hosting_completed：托管完成，云账号托管流程执行成功，相关权限模板与托管绑定已生效。
hosting_failed：托管失败，托管流程执行异常，可查看失败原因后重新发起托管。
hosting_removing：移除中，移除托管任务已提交并异步执行中，需等待移除流程完成后进入最终状态。
hosting_remove_failed：移除失败，移除托管流程执行异常，可查看失败原因后重新发起移除

PrivilegeStatus.description_en:
The privilege switch status. Valid values:
enabled: Enabled. The resource is active and can be used normally.
disabled: Disabled. The resource is deactivated and no longer takes effect. You can re-enable it to restore functionality
PrivilegeStatus.description_zh:
特权开关状态，取值可选范围：
enabled：启用，资源处于生效状态，可正常使用。
disabled：禁用，资源处于停用状态，不再生效，可重新启用恢复

UpdateTime.description_en: The last update time, in UNIX timestamp format, measured in milliseconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: 最近更新时间，Unix 时间戳格式，单位为毫秒

MaxResults.description_en: The number of rows per page for paging

NextToken.description_en: The token returned for this request
NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证（Token）值
NextToken.title_en: 本次调用返回的查询凭证（Token）值。
NextToken.title_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证（Token）值。

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
